title: Continuous Improvement Director
text:
Have you ever u sed the self-checkout? Played the slots at a Casino? Maybe you grabbed a drink from a vending machine or paid to park your car? If you’ve answered with a resounding “YES”, then you’ve done so with the aid of one of the 10 million devices installed by Crane Payment Innovations (CPI).
 
 
We make the technology that powers your everyday life, enabling more than 4 billion transactions every week in more than 143 currencies worldwide. From cash and coins to cards and mobile, we keep the world of payments moving with smart validation devices and business management software.
 
 
Headquartered in Malvern, PA, CPI is supported by: ~2,000 global associates, 6 manufacturing sites, more than 10 corporate offices and a global field service organization.
 
 
**What You’ll Be Doing**
We are seeking a strategic and influential CBS Director for the Service Business Unit to build and facilitate the business system that turns strategy into execution. This role owns how we execute and improve as a business. The Director will lead strategy deployment and the transformation review cadence, develop repeatable growth and operating processes, and use daily management and kaizen to improve cross-functional performance. You will build and facilitate the Service business system that connects strategy, growth, customer experience, service capabilities, and operational execution. Working through functional leaders and initiative owners, you will make priorities, progress, barriers, and improvement opportunities visible while preserving clear accountability for business results and execution.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Service business system: Design, implement, and continuously improve the management system used to translate Service Business Unit strategy into coordinated execution across functions.
* Strategy deployment: Facilitate the process for converting strategic priorities into defined initiatives, outcomes, measures, milestones, owners, and review routines.
* Transformation review cadence: Lead a consistent transformation review process that makes progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected benefits visible to business leadership.
* Accountability model: Maintain clear governance, templates, and escalation paths while preserving accountability with initiative owners for delivering and reporting their results.
* Growth processes: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Service leadership to develop a repeatable growth system spanning market mapping, target account selection, lead generation, account planning, opportunity qualification, funnel management, initiative launch, cross-functional readiness, benefit tracking, and revenue launch and ramp performance.
* Growth performance management: Establish practical measures and review routines that help leaders identify and address gaps in pipeline coverage, conversion, sales cycle time, launch performance, and progress against growth commitments.
* Operating processes: Standardize critical cross-functional processes where consistency, ownership, handoffs, or decision speed constrain execution.
* Daily management: Establish practical daily management routines, visual controls, performance measures, and escalation mechanisms that enable teams to identify and resolve issues at the appropriate level.
* Kaizen and continuous improvement: Identify, scope, facilitate, and sustain kaizen activity focused on meaningful cross-functional business priorities, using appropriate CBS tools and disciplined follow-through.
* Cross-functional performance: Partner across Operations, Commercial, Customer Experience, Quality, Technical Enablement, Service Offerings, Finance, HR, and other functions to improve end-to-end outcomes rather than isolated departmental measures.
* Problem solving and process improvement: Coach teams in structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, process mapping, standard work, action planning, and benefit validation.
* Performance visibility: Develop an integrated view of initiative progress, operating performance, growth metrics, risks, benefits, and corrective actions for leadership review.
* Capability building: Build business-system capability by coaching leaders and initiative owners, facilitating working sessions, and embedding repeatable methods rather than assuming ownership of their deliverables.
* Sustainment: Confirm that improvements are adopted, measured, and sustained through standard work, ownership, governance, and follow-up reviews.
* Enterprise learning: Document effective practices, scale them across the Service business, and share proven approaches more broadly within CPI where appropriate.
* Executive communication: Provide concise, fact-based updates on transformation progress, cross-functional performance, barriers, decisions required and realized benefits.

**Qualifications And Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience in continuous improvement, business transformation, strategy deployment, operational excellence, or business-system development.
* Demonstrated experience building or advancing an operating or business system that connects strategic priorities to execution and measurable results.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with commercial leaders on funnel management, account planning, opportunity qualification, or another measurable growth process.
* Strong working knowledge of lean management methods, including kaizen, daily management, visual management, value-stream or process mapping, standard work, and structured problem solving.
* Experience facilitating complex, cross-functional initiatives while maintaining clear accountability with business and initiative owners.
* Ability to design governance, review cadences, performance measures, and escalation routines that improve execution without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Excellent analytical, planning, facilitation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with frontline teams, functional leaders, and executives.
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to establish credibility, challenge constructively, and move groups toward decisions and deliverables in a matrixed environment.
* Experience in a service-intensive, field-service, industrial technology, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or comparable advanced continuous-improvement certification preferred.
* Ability to travel to support Service operations, transformation activity, and kaizen events as business needs require.

**Personal Attributes**

* Enterprise thinker: Connects strategy, growth, customer experience, capabilities, operating performance, and financial outcomes.
* System builder: Creates simple, repeatable management processes that clarify priorities, ownership, measures, and decisions.
* Facilitative leader: Enables leaders and initiative owners to execute successfully without taking accountability away from them.
* Results oriented: Focuses improvement activity on measurable business outcomes and sustained benefits.
* Objective and analytical: Uses facts, process evidence, and performance data to identify constraints and guide decisions.
* Constructive challenger: Surfaces gaps, risks, and trade-offs directly while maintaining trust and productive relationships.
* Change leader: Builds understanding, engagement, and adoption across functions and levels of the organization.
* Disciplined communicator: Makes progress, barriers, decisions, and accountability visible through concise and consistent communication.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
Service has a consistent, measurable growth process from market opportunity through qualified pipeline, launch, and revenue ramp. Leaders use a disciplined strategy and transformation review cadence to address gaps, resolve barriers, and make timely decisions. Improvements become part of how teams work, with clear measures, sustained standard work, and ownership that continues beyond each kaizen event or initiative launch.
 
 
**What We’re Offering**

* Base $190-210K
* Hybrid role
* Defined career growth plans with opportunities to go outside of your “comfort zone”
* Generous paid time off, including sick and holiday
* Medical, dental, & vision insurance
* 401K with Company contribution
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Discounts for childcare
* Tuition assistance
* Community involvement and volunteering events
* Opportunities to travel and work at our global sites

Sound interesting? Come see why we are !
 
 
**CPI is part of Crane NXT**
Crane NXT is a premier industrial technology company that provides proprietary and trusted technology solutions to secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers. The company is a pioneer in advanced, proprietary micro-optics technology for securing physical products, and its sophisticated electronic equipment and associated software leverages proprietary core capabilities with detection and sensing technologies. Crane NXT has approximately 4,000 employees with global operations and manufacturing facilities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Mexico, Japan, Switzerland, Germany, Sweden, and Malta. For more information, visit www.cranenxt.com.
 
 
*Crane Payment Innovations is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. Applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, military status, or national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.*
